title: The Last Debt
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: Dominic Iversen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
